descriptors.label: Public FQDN
descriptors.description: Fully qualified name this appliance is reached by; used for the TLS certificate and printed as the ingestion endpoint. Empty derives it from the guest hostname and the addresses held at first boot

descriptors.label: Time Zone
descriptors.description: IANA time zone for the host's logs, for example Europe/Prague; empty means UTC. The containers keep their own clocks in UTC either way

descriptors.label: Metrics Allowlist
descriptors.description: Space or comma separated addresses/CIDRs allowed to scrape /node-metrics; empty leaves node-exporter switched off

descriptors.label: NetBox URL
descriptors.description: The NetBox this appliance reconciles into, for example https://netbox.example.com. That NetBox must have the Diode NetBox plugin installed. Empty is allowed: the appliance still starts and accepts ingest, and can be pointed at a NetBox later with diode-netbox

descriptors.label: NetBox CA Bundle (base64 PEM)
descriptors.description: Base64-encoded PEM certificate authority bundle used to verify the NetBox connection. Needed in practice when NetBox uses a private or self-signed certificate - which the NetBox appliance in this repository ships by default. Empty uses the system trust store

descriptors.label: Skip NetBox TLS Verification
descriptors.description: Last resort only: disables certificate verification for the NetBox connection entirely. Supply a CA bundle above instead wherever possible

descriptors.label: HTTP(S) Proxy
descriptors.description: Proxy for the appliance's own outbound traffic, for example http://proxy.example.com:3128. Needed for Ubuntu security updates and for pulling a new Diode release on a network without direct internet access. Empty means connect directly

descriptors.label: Proxy Bypass List
descriptors.description: Comma-separated hosts, domains and CIDRs reached without the proxy, for example .internal.example.com,10.0.0.0/8. localhost and the appliance's own addresses are always bypassed

descriptors.label: TLS Certificate Chain (base64 PEM)
descriptors.description: Base64-encoded PEM certificate chain for nginx; empty generates a self-signed certificate. HSTS is only sent when a certificate is supplied here, because HSTS makes a self-signed warning impossible to click through

descriptors.label: TLS Private Key (base64 PEM)
descriptors.description: Base64-encoded PEM private key matching the certificate above; required only when a certificate is supplied

descriptors.label: Run Discovery Agent On This Appliance
descriptors.description: Runs the NetBox Discovery agent on this VM. Suitable for a single site: the agent has to reach the devices it scans, so a multi-site network wants agents out at each site pointed at this appliance instead. Off by default

descriptors.label: Discovery Targets
descriptors.description: Space or comma separated addresses, ranges or CIDRs the agent scans hourly, for example 192.0.2.0/24. Required when the agent is enabled. Device credentials are deliberately NOT collected here - a value entered on this form is stored in the VM configuration in cleartext; set them afterwards with: sudo diode-agent credentials
